records.title: Rad-R: A Raw-ADC Radar Dataset and Capture-Invariant SSM for Hardware-Fault Diagnosis
records.reason: Radar hardware-fault diagnosis and dataset construction are unrelated to LLM inference.

records.title: WiSDoM: Wireless Sparse Decision Transformer with Mixture-of-Experts for Multi-Task Mobile Network Optimization
records.reason: Wireless resource optimization with a sparse Decision Transformer/MoE is not LLM serving or inference.

records.title: Free the Language Model From the Vision Encoder: Semantic Serialization as a Perception Interface for Small Language Models
records.reason: Semantic serialization lets a small language model consume structured perception, but primary results show the perception stack still dominates and total compute is not lower.

records.title: SOMTab: Set-Order Mamba for Efficient Tabular In-Context Learning
records.reason: SOMTab is efficient tabular in-context learning, not a language model, though its selective Mamba/attention design is architecturally adjacent to efficient long-context inference.

records.title: Hypervision: An on-chip hyperspectral microsystem for online video-rate computational imaging.
records.reason: The hyperspectral imaging NPU performs computational imaging, not LLM inference.
